notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Anew patch is now live. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where pop-up menus would not appear anymore if the clay in the throwing process was broken by a hammer.
[*] Fixed a bug when entering steam system menu while pickink up items.
[/list]

Thank you for playing DOJAGI: The Korean Pottery.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
A new patch is now live. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932100/a0a4292175ab7a8bbd3e88e98342a77d8c58a591.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new items into in-game shop. All of the new items are Korean traditional furniture or traditional wooden crafts. (Korean traditional totems, Korean traditional wooden ducks, and etc so on...)
[*] "Fill Color": Now you can fill your pottery with the color you want at once.
[*] We changed the "Undo" function. Previously "Undo" reverted your actions for each painting tools, but for now it will revert all your actions regardless of the tools.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some tool tips in the Showroom.
[*] Fixed a issue related to collision. So items will not fall under the floor.
[*] Fixed some issues that caused a game to stuck while moving your furniture.
[*] And other some bugs fixed.
[/list]


Thank you for playing DOJAGI: The Korean Pottery.

notes.title: Beta Update #3
notes.notes:
The final update for beta version is now live. Please read below to learn about the latest changes.

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Allows you to set new options for B/Y buttons for Oculus Touch users.  The default value is mapped to the same function as the "A" and "X" buttons. However, functions such as taking a screenshot or moving to directly to the default pottery wheel are available by changing options in the 'Settings'.
[*] Auto Pause: When you remove HMD, the game will pause automatically. 
If you want to resume the game, simply press the Trigger button with the headset on. This function can be toggle in 'Settings'. Steam version only
[*] Changed the default item setting for Cottage scenario. It does not affect your previous saved file.
[*] Improved the logic that determines pottery types.
[*] In some tasks in Career mode, a sample that your customer wants will be sent to SMS.
[*] New log system added. The game generate a file named 'DOJAGI.log' in the document folder ever time it runs. It will only be created automatically, but not sent to us automatically. So if you need technical support, please send it to us.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues on overall performance of the game.
[*] Removed a splash screen.
[*] Fixed some problems on hands.
[*] Fixed some problems on throwing.
[/list]

Please note that the beta testing will be ended on December 3, 01:00 UTC. After that time, your beta CD-KEY will be disabled and we will provide a full version CD-KEY only to beta testers who have given use helpful feedback.

Thank you.

notes.title: Beta Update #2
notes.notes:
A new update is now live for this weekend. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved responsiveness of Air Menu controls.
[*] Added new options related to Air-Menu controls. Now you can adjust the height and distance of the menu.
[*] Improved the logic of shape detection for potteries.
[*] Improved performance of particle effects highly.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the way to deliver rewards in the competition and career scenario.
[*] When using the female hand skin, the problem of pointing fingers indicate the wrong direction fixed.
[*] Fixed a pointing pose issue for female hands.
[*] Fixed a bug of achievements.
[*] Fixed a bug of in-game camera. - Wrong field-of-depth
[*] Removed a pottery status icon from the photo that taken by in-game digital camera and smartphone.
[*] Changed the angle of Trophies when you grip.
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Beta Update #1
notes.notes:
A new patch is now live. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. 

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932100/cfdab7abd838607341cbe7c7c0cffb54c613cda4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a new guidance system for competition. But it's only for 'Easy' difficulty and all competitions of Career mode. So for Normal/Hard mode of competitions will require a vernier caliper to measure exact size.
[*] Added buttons for competition. You can finish competition and toggle the guidance for competition.
[*] Now you can wet your hands more easily.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Moonlight club competition will give you "Moonlight Memorial Tablet" for a scenario reward. You don't need to win a prize for the tablet anymore.
[*] Fixed competition scoring.
[*] Fixed bugs on subtitles.
[*] Now you can wet your hands more easily.
[*] Fixed some issues caused crashes.
[*] Changed manipulation logic for the digital camera.(aperture/auto focus) Easy to control details, sound problem fixed.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and thanks for all your feedback, testers.
